senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Lemuel, homiletical surname of Solomon.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ל׳ שנם̇ ל̇א̇ל̇ בלבו</he> (not <he>בכל לבו</he>) he was surnamed L. because he spoke against God in his heart (saying, I may take many wives and yet not be seduced to sin); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1:2">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite>.
